newsitem.title: USA: Cabot Oil buys Equitable Wyoming stake.
newsitem.headline: Cabot Oil buys Equitable Wyoming stake.

text.p: Cabot Oil & Gas Corp said Monday it agreed to purchase the Green River Basin assets in Wyoming of Equitable Resources Inc for $44 million.

Cabot Oil said it will receive proved hydrocarbon reserves of some 74 billion cubic feet equivalent (bcfe) from interests in 65 wells, current daily production totaling about 10 million cubic feet equivalent net (mcfe) and nearly 70 potential drilling locations.

The company said it will initially fund this transaction from its revolving credit facility while looking at several options to repay the incremental debt, including the possibility of accepting offers for non-strategic properties.
Closing of the purchase is scheduled for the end of September, Cabot said.

"This acquisition, when coupled with the sale of non-strategic assets, is another significant step in the rationalization program begun in 1995 to provide our shareholders with a better mix of high performing assets and high potential drilling locations," said Chief Executive Officer Charles Siess Jr.
